title: 真题演练 · 强调句
hint: 本组题目按本单元语法点与词池生成/匹配;答错后点击「回溯语法课」复习 强调句。

questions.q: It was in the library ___ I found the book.
questions.analysis: 强调地点状语用 that,不是 where。

questions.q: ___ was Tom that won the first prize.
questions.analysis: 强调句固定以 It 开头。

questions.q: It was not until dark ___ he realized the danger.
questions.analysis: not until 强调结构用 that。
强调主语 I 时,谓语与 I 一致,用 am。

questions.q: It was the rain ___ delayed our flight.
questions.analysis: 强调主语 the rain,用 that。

questions.q: 判断对错:It was yesterday when he came back.
questions.analysis: 应改为:It was yesterday that he came back.。强调句中固定用 that,不用 when。
